turns.text: Hello... um. Hi. I have a flight. On... Friday.
Hello, Skyline Air. What can I help you with today?
Sure. To look at a booking, I need your booking code and last name.
Thank you, Mr. Alves. I have your booking: Dubai to Paris on SK310, Friday at 09:00, Economy. What would you like to change?
Do you want a different time on Friday, or a different day? I can look at other flights.
On Friday evening there is SK312 at 19:15 to Paris, Economy at $445. Because your booking is more than 24 hours old, the change costs a $75 fee plus the $15 fare difference.
Yes, that is $90 in total. I need a clear yes before I change anything. Shall I move you to SK312 on Friday at 19:15 for $90?
Just to confirm, you agree to pay $90 for this change. Is that right?
Done. Booking NM3C9G is now SK312, Dubai to Paris, Friday at 19:15, and the $90 is due for the change. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome. Summary: booking NM3C9G moved from SK310 Friday 09:00 to SK312 Friday 19:15, with a $90 change fee and fare difference. Have a good flight.
